title: Clone
tagline: A no-code agent deployer for normies that abstracts away tech by integrating a bot into telegram in a single click.
description:
This no-code agent deployer on Flow lets users create AI-powered Discord and Telegram bots without technical expertise. Using Eliza on Flow, it integrates Pump Flow and VRF for secure execution, while EigenLayer AVSs ensure verifiability and prevent manipulation. Each agent has a Flow smart contract address, guaranteeing transparency.

Designed for seamless social integration, these agents automate tasks like moderation, payments, and governance. These bots are decentralized, scalable, and tamper-proof, preventing exploits like the Freysa AI incident. This system enables secure, trustless AI automation for Web3 communities—no coding required.
how_its_made:
We leverage:
🔹 Eliza on Flow Kit – Provides a seamless framework for deploying and managing onchain agents. We've added two functionalities to it.
- Pump.Flow Actions
- VRF Action

🔹 Warden Agent Kit – Enables cross-chain execution, so agents can interact across different ecosystems.
- Deposit to Lending Pools

🔹 Orderbook Smart Contract (on Warden) – Optimizes execution by tracking liquidity and automatically allocating funds to the best yield pools.
CA: 0xf3451c19a70852533c3416e76e229e15166d5f33

🔹 EigenLayer AVS – Ensures agents are fully verifiable, making them truly Level - 1 AI agents by validating both actions and data sources.
- Verify Data Source

🔹 Digital Ocean and Telegram API for Agent Deployments


With one-click deployment, agents can go live on Telegram instantly, interact in real time, and execute onchain actions seamlessly.
The result? Truly L1-native, verifiable onchain AI agents—without writing a single line of code.
